demo_title: Neon rain turnback I2V memory advantage
one_sentence_takeaway: Under the same keyframe, task, model, duration, and storyboard, the memory-backed lane showed more stable repeat behavior while remaining a bounded visual signal.

experiment_setup.user_task: Create a 15 second vertical 3D anime cinematic video where the same young woman crosses a neon rain street, turns back to camera, and stops under a flickering neon sign.
storyboard_checkpoints: 6-10s light sweep and rain partially obscure face and torso
13-15s stop under flickering abstract neon sign

input_difference.baseline: current task plus source keyframe only

observation_table.note: Baseline repeats varied more in camera path; memory-backed repeats kept the five checkpoints closer.
Memory-backed repeats recovered the same face and high ponytail more consistently after motion.
Memory-backed repeats retained white top, blue jeans, and white sneakers with less drift.
Both lanes kept neon rain, but memory-backed repeats aligned reflections and sign-light timing more closely.
After rain and light sweep occlusion, memory-backed repeats returned to a more similar readable character.
Both lanes have model drift; memory-backed repeats were steadier, but this remains subjective visual evidence.

slidev_outline.title: 实验问题
bullets: 同一关键帧、同一剧本、同一模型下，记忆上下文能否降低重复生成的发散？
任务：Create a 15 second vertical 3D anime cinematic video where the same young woman crosses a neon rain street, turns back to camera, and stops under a flickering neon sign.
结论边界：这是 demo 观察信号，不是最终验收。

slidev_outline.title: 输入差异
bullets: Baseline：当前任务 + 源关键帧。
Memory-backed：额外使用角色记忆、场景记忆、反馈补丁。
其余条件保持一致：模型、时长、分镜、源关键帧。

slidev_outline.title: 可讲清楚的边界
bullets: 是可复核的重复生成稳定性案例。

speaker_notes: 这不是一次提示词炫技，而是把相同任务在重复生成下的稳定性差异记录下来。
Baseline 每次都依赖当前输入自行发散；memory-backed 复用角色、场景和反馈记忆来收窄发散空间。
当前证据适合比赛演示和架构说明，不适合说成最终产品质量证明。
